what: Installer, installed-size and idle/warm RSS budgets for the v1 Windows artifacts, enforced by scripts/check-size-budget.mjs.
note: Ceilings are hard: exceeding one fails the release job that produced the artifact. `baseline` is the last recorded measurement; when it is present the gate additionally fails on a regression worse than `regression_threshold_pct`, which is the 'agreed threshold' of the row. A null baseline means 'no artifact has been measured yet' — the gate says so out loud rather than pretending the check ran.

basis.installer_nsis_bytes: LZMA-compressed NSIS installer of the shell + the compiled coordinator sidecar. Provisional until the first measured bundle (P70.E9); the ceiling is deliberately loose so a first measurement records reality instead of a guess.
basis.installer_msi_bytes: WiX MSI is uncompressed-by-default per-component and therefore materially larger than NSIS; budgeted higher on purpose.
basis.installed_bytes: Application binary + the bundled coordinator sidecar + icons. The webview and the OS runtime are provided by Windows and are not part of this figure.
basis.idle_rss_mb: Combined RSS (Rust core + coordinator sidecar + webview) after a quiet period. The spec's <30MB idle / <80MB warm numbers are the Rust core only and are 'targets to verify, not promises' (DESKTOP-APP-SPEC.md R6); the Bun-compiled sidecar alone measures ~93MB (J16), so the honest combined ceiling is far above that.
basis.warm_rss_mb: Combined RSS after active work (a live session with the sidecar warm).
basis.measured_by: crates/everyaios-core/src/rss_measure.rs (measure_idle_and_warm) for RSS; the produced bundle for sizes.
